targets.outcome_reasoning: All original numbers are reproduced from analysis data. Regional controls materially weaken the cross-country result and corrected stable-border inclusion removes one US result; those are substantive robustness challenges under the at-least-one rule. Authors nevertheless regard the wider overall conclusion as intact, which is recorded without treating that global assessment as erasing the specific caveats.
